text.en:
Sitio Baclingayan, Taleb, Mintangeb, Dataan, Napo, Ampongan and Tabbac of Barangays Kili,
Alangtin and Tubtuba, in the Municipality of Tubo, province of Abra, are hereby detached and separated
therefrom to form and constitute into a distinct and independent barangay which is hereby created to be
known as Barangay Tab a without affecting in any manner the legal existence of the mother Barangays of
Kili, Alangtin and Tubtuba.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
barangays shall be applicable to the new barangay of Tab a.

The present action elective barangay officials of Barangay Kili shall continue to perform their
duties as such officials in the newly-created Barangay Tab a until the officials of said barangay shall have
been appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall hold office until their successors shall have
been elected in the regular elections following the issuance of this Decree and shall have qualified, unless
sooner removed at the pleasure of the President. Such appointed officers and employees as may be necessary
to organize or to complete the government personnel of Barangay Tab a shall be appointed as provided for
under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of the new Barangay of Tab a in the
obligations, funds, assets and other property of Barangays Kili, Alangtin and Tubtuba shall be transferred by
the President of the newly-created barangay upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as all executive orders or regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
